script.vo: That was the promise behind a nine billion dollar company.

script.vo: In two thousand three, Elizabeth Holmes founded Theranos at nineteen, then dropped out of Stanford.

script.vo: The pitch: a full set of blood tests from one finger prick, on its Edison machine.

In January two thousand twenty-two, Holmes was found guilty of defrauding investors.
